parameters.name: NodeType
parameters.description:
The node type. Required when you query the PolarDB search node account

- Search

parameters.name: PageNumber
parameters.description: The page number of the returned page. The value must be an integer that is larger than 0. The default value is **1**.

parameters.name: PageSize
parameters.description:
The number of entries returned per page. Valid values:

- **30**

- **50**

- **100**

The default value is **30**.
